translated: And now, we have the song written specifically for this event by Kuriyama Yuri,
"Hanamusubi". Wow, my pronunciation was great just then.
The 2D MV...
The 2D MV was just released a moment ago.
I mean, it really was just now.
It hasn't even been an hour yet.
Since it's out, let's watch it together and talk about the song.
First, let's take a look at the 2D MV.
Finding the conclusion I'd waited for all along in this night.
Hurriedly hiding it, pretending not to know, enduring the pain of a love forced into a shape that doesn't fit, always feeling cramped, yet unable to speak.
I'm afraid.
If I speak,
it feels like everything will crumble, so I keep my lips sealed.
Speak,
no matter what, speak,
and unravel this heart of mine.
Unchanging,
pinning back my hair,
connecting the threads of fate to become a blooming flower, seeking a glimmer of hope in the gaps of an unchanging tomorrow.
I've realized what true hope is.
We just watched "Hanamusubi", and that 2D MV is just incredible.
It's the best.
Since Kuriyama-san wrote this for us, I'd like to talk a bit about the recording session.
During recording, they usually give us an explanation beforehand about the story and what kind of song it is.
When I heard the details and saw the song before the recording,
I could really feel how much of this event's story and Saki Tenma's feelings
were poured into the writing. It really came through in the music.
You can definitely feel Kuriyama-san's signature style and melody in there too.
Kuriyama-san also shared some comments about it on the Wondershow Channel.
